title: Our doctoral candidates begin their PhDs
summary: MITIME’s doctoral candidates have taken up their posts at seven universities across Europe.
body:
This autumn MITIME’s doctoral candidates started their three-year PhD projects at the universities of Oulu, Bochum, Liège, Cork, Istanbul (Koç), Bilbao (Deusto) and Rotterdam (Erasmus).

Over the coming months they will begin fieldwork planning, join the online Introduction to MITIME course and meet their associated-partner mentors. Meet them on the [doctoral candidates](/doctoral-candidates/) page.
